author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಮಜ್ಜಿಗೆಯ ಕಡೆಯುವಿಕೆ ನವನೀತ ತರುವಂತೆ
ಸಜ್ಜನಿಕೆ ಬೆಳಗಲಿದೆ ಕಷ್ಟಸುಖ ಸಹಿಸೆ
ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಮುಂದಿಡೆ ನೋವು ನಲಿವುಗಳನೆದುರಿಸಲು
ಉಜ್ಜಲವೆ ಜೀವನವು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: As churning buttermilk brings up fresh butter,
goodness will shine once you bear hardship and joy;
step forward to face pain and pleasure,
and life itself is radiant, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Just as churning yields butter, going through life’s ups and downs brings out our goodness. Face both with courage, and life becomes bright.
